channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Paul Martin is joined by experts Kate Bateman and Adam Partridge as they explore the collectables at a valuation day in the spa town of Malvern. Adam gets in a spin over a wooden top that reminds him of his childhood, and Kate hopes she's struck gold with some coins that could be worth thousands. Paul takes a break from the antiques and tries his hand at some woodwork - meeting a local man who's been making violins for over 40 years.
